description: This Java class 'XslTransform' provides a static method to perform XSL transformations on XML data, making use of Java's javax.xml.transform libraries, and includes caching for XSL templates. It handles security features for XML processing, creates and configures SAX parsers, and applies XSL templates to XML data, returning the transformed output as a string.

classes.name: XslTransform
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to perform XSL transformations on XML documents with internal caching of compiled templates.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Performs an XSL transformation on the provided XML data using a specified XSL template, returning the transformed result as a string. It configures the transformer and SAX parser with security features and optional XInclude support.
